description: Hello! My name is Rafael Dominguez and I am an Electrical Engineering student at Lone Star College Kingwood. This will be my first ever hackathon, however I am a great problem solver and fast learner. I am highly disciplined and a responsible team member. If you do not choose to join that's totally cool.
summary: I developed a 2d pixel game designed around teaching people from all over the world about the different layers in spacesuits. My game takes you through parkour platforming and fun mini games making for an immersive fun and relaxing experience accompanied by music made by me as well. I found this project deeply personal despite being so simple. Many people like me feel they waited too long to find something to be passionate about. However, all it takes is a good course that can change your life. For me, finding creative and interactive experiences to learn about topics I'm passionate about has led to many of my successes.
details: Koala in Space is an interactive game that entertains you, and enlightens you. The intended impact is to show others that learning can be fun and easy. Claude was the only AI used. My project is creative because it incorporates music made by me, art made by me, and dialogue written by me to create an immersive experience that makes the learning the fun part.
